title: Western Michigan · 11–1
text: Western won its first seven games and finished the regular season 11–1, scoring 380 points and allowing 193. Its only loss came against Central Michigan; four straight wins afterward included a season-ending shutout of Kent State.

title: Eastern Michigan · 4–8
text: Eastern opened 2–0 but finished 4–8, with seven losses decided by eight points or fewer. The Eagles scored 202 points and allowed 227, pairing wins over Buffalo and Akron with a difficult finish against Central Michigan.

title: Central Michigan · 11–1
text: Central closed the regular season with ten straight wins and swept both Michigan rivals. The Chippewas scored 396 points and allowed just 142, giving them the strongest scoring margin and opponent-adjusted rating of the three programs.
